literal: Modesty fence without-having indeed vast world they-will-not-cherish high-ones.
translation: The noble ones will not desire even the vast world if it means living without the fence of modesty.
modern: மேன்மையானவர்கள் நாணம் என்னும் வேலியை விட்டுவிட்டு, இந்தப் பரந்த உலகத்தை ஆள்வதையும் விரும்ப மாட்டார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes that noble people value modesty above all worldly possessions. The word 'நாண்' (modesty or a sense of shame against doing wrong) is compared to a protective 'வேலி' (fence) that guards their character. The phrase 'கொள்ளாது... பேணலர்' indicates that without maintaining this fence, they would not cherish even the vast world ('வியன் ஞாலம்'). Thus, true greatness lies in preserving one's moral boundaries rather than acquiring limitless power or wealth.
